# cellxgene_groups_v

One row per CELLxGENE cell group: the cells of one dataset sharing tissue, cell type,
disease, assay and suspension type, with cell and donor counts. Lists every group, including
those below the 50-cell / 3-donor threshold that have no expression rows. Use it to see
which cell types, tissues and diseases the data covers.

## Worked examples

Queries that run against cellxgene_groups_v as written.

### Cells and donors per disease for one rolled-up cell type

```sql
SELECT disease, SUM(n_cells) AS cells, SUM(n_donors) AS donors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT dataset_id) AS datasets
FROM cellxgene_groups_v WHERE cell_type_rollup = 'T cell' GROUP BY disease ORDER BY cells DESC
```
